name: holdings
description: IP portfolio system-of-record CLI + MCP + serve. SQLite at <data home>/holdings.db is authoritative when no DATABASE_URL is configured; with one, reads/writes go directly to the operator-owned Postgres. The data home resolves via @hasna/paths: the legacy ~/.hasna/holdings default (storage.sqlitePath) stays effective until the store is adopted — HASNA_DATA_HOME set, or holdings.db already present at the resolver home — and HASNA_HOLDINGS_HOME/HOLDINGS_HOME override the app home unconditionally; HASNA_HOLDINGS_DB_PATH/HOLDINGS_DB_PATH override the database path.
